title: States
searchPlaceholder: Search by name, loc key, id, owner…
emptyNoStates: No states yet. Seed every vanilla state below to start editing, or use the sidebar Import Mod Folder.
selectHint: Pick one from the list on the left. States are grouped by owner.
displayNameHint: The name shown in-game and in the list. Edit it to rename this state: it writes a localisation override, and the internal key (STATE_613 style) never changes. Clear a field to go back to the base game's name.
ownerHint: Country TAG that starts owning this state.
coresHint: Countries that consider this a core territory (add_core_of).
removeCoresHint: Countries whose core on this state is removed (remove_core_of).
buildingsHint: infrastructure / arms_factory / industrial_complex / dockyard / air_base … Province-level buildings (naval_base etc.) are placed below.
provinceBuildingsHint: Place per-province buildings (naval_base, coastal_bunker, bunker…) by province id. DLC-gated province blocks are preserved automatically and not shown here.
controllerHint: Leave empty when the controller is the same as the owner.
provinceControllersHint: Override the controller of individual provinces (set_province_controller).
stateCategoryHint: Free text — custom categories from KR/TNO etc. are accepted.
localSuppliesHint: Leave empty to use the default.
buildingsMaxLevelFactorHint: Multiplier on every building's max level (buildings_max_level_factor). Leave empty for the default.
impassableHint: Troops cannot enter and provincial buildings cannot be built here. In game it renders as impassable terrain — which reads as the state having vanished. Vanilla only uses this for wasteland and enclaves.
impassableCategoryMismatch: This state is marked impassable but its category is "{category}". Vanilla only pairs impassable with wasteland or enclave. Saving still works — this is just worth a look.
impassableMissingForceLink: Pick the neighbouring state this land's ownership follows. All 21 of vanilla's impassable states set it (measured on 1.19.2 — this field is not in the wiki); without it nobody owns this land.
forceLinkOwnershipToHint: The state_id of the neighbouring state this wasteland inherits its owner from. All 21 impassable states in the base game set it; leave it empty and the wasteland has nothing to follow.
impassableIgnoredLinksHint: 1.19: neighbour state ids this impassable state keeps its connection to — no braces here. Separate them with spaces or new lines; saving normalizes them to one space-separated list, and the export re-wraps it in the impassable_ignored_links block. Leave empty to omit the key.
name: Name
nameLocNote: Localisation key, read-only. Rename via Display name above (it writes a localisation override); this key never changes.
provincesHint: Whitespace-separated positive province IDs. Duplicate IDs are blocked. You may temporarily leave this empty to inspect the change; the program validates the final membership when you save.
provinceInvalidTokens: Use positive whole-number province IDs. Invalid: {tokens}
provinceDuplicateIds: Each province may appear only once. Duplicates: {ids}
provinceEmptyDraft: This draft has no provinces. You can keep reviewing it, but save may be rejected if the final membership is invalid.
membershipLegacyUnknownHint: This state was imported before we started saving import snapshots, so we can't show what has changed since. It doesn't affect your export — there's nothing to fix.
rawExtrasNote: {count} extra block(s) preserved verbatim (date overrides, province buildings, unknown keys).
readonlyHint: These are kept exactly as imported and round-trip back on export.
previewPreserveNote: Editing the fields on the left keeps every preserved block (date overrides, province-level buildings, unknown keys) intact.
previewEmpty: Select a state to see its summary.
selectHintMap: Click a state on the map to edit it.
mapUnavailable: The state map geometry hasn't been generated yet. You can still edit every state from the list view.
mapUnavailableFor: The map geometry for this base mod ({source}) hasn't been generated yet. You can still edit every state from the list view.
mapLegendVanillaContentOk: content preserved / not a vanilla state
mapVanillaContentHint: These came from the vanilla template. Naval bases, bunkers, landmarks and dated history in vanilla's own script were not included.
mapMembershipStaticHint: Only states with verified membership changes are highlighted. This static basemap does not redraw province boundaries.
mapAdoptNotInBase: State {id} isn't in the base game's data, so it can't be opened from the map. Try the list view.
mapAdoptNoRow: State {id} couldn't be added to this project. Try the list view.
mapLegendPolitical: One color per owner · gray = no owner
emptyHeroTitle: The map is where your story takes place
emptyHeroDesc: Seed every vanilla state first, then reshape them into your world
mapSearchNoHits: No match. Try a state id.
bulkConfirmSkipped: {count} of them are already at the target value and will be skipped
bulkConfirmNoop: Every selected state is already at the target value — nothing to change.
bulkNotInProject: {count} of them aren't in this project yet and will be skipped
mapMultiSelectHint: Shift + drag to box-select · Ctrl/Cmd + click to add one
deleteConfirmBody: This removes the state from this project only — the base game data is untouched, and you can seed it again later.
deleteConfirmEdited: This state has been edited. Deleting it discards your changes to it.
deleteRefreshFailed: State {id} was deleted, but the list could not be refreshed: {msg}
clearSeededBody: This deletes the {count} states in this project that you have not edited.
clearSeededImportedNote: If this project imported a full mod, the imported states also count as unedited and will be cleared along with the seeded ones.
clearSeededKeepEdited: States you have edited are kept — they are skipped even if they are selected.
clearSeededRefreshFailed: The states were cleared, but the list could not be refreshed: {msg}
